# Peerstellation

Peerstellation is a web-only, real-time 3D observatory for peers reachable from a browser-hosted Helia/libp2p node. The sky is rendered from measured session observations; it never fabricates peers, latency, or topology.

## Primary pages

- [Peerstellation live observatory](https://ipfsuniverse.xyz/): the interactive 3D peer observatory.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/tadanobutubutu/peerstellation): TypeScript, Rust WebAssembly, and Zig WebAssembly source.
- [Documentation](https://github.com/tadanobutubutu/peerstellation#readme): setup, safety boundaries, and deployment notes.

## Usage boundaries

- Peer data is ephemeral and scoped to the current browser session.
- Local Kubo daemon inspection requires an explicit user action and a narrowly configured CORS origin.
- Do not infer a complete IPFS network graph from this observatory; it only displays evidence available to the current browser node.

## Technical references

- [Helia documentation](https://helia.org/)
- [libp2p documentation](https://libp2p.io/)
